---
title: "Flights Density"
subtitle: "Density heatmap and contour lines for 200,000+ flights, by departure hour and arrival delay."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [Flights Density](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/flights-density.html)
from the mosaic/vgplot example gallery. The sliders adjust the
smoothing (bandwidth) and number of contour thresholds.

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
bandwidth <- param(bandwidth)
thresholds <- param(thresholds)

spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "Flights Density",
    description = paste(
      "Density `heatmap` and `contour` lines for 200,000+ flights by departure hour and",
      "arrival delay. The sliders adjust the smoothing (bandwidth) and number of contour",
      "thresholds."
    )
  ) |>
  vg_data(name = "flights", file = vg_example_url("flights-200k.parquet")) |>
  vg_params(bandwidth = 7, thresholds = 10) |>
  vg_vconcat(
    vg_hconcat(
      vg_slider(label = "Bandwidth (σ)", as = bandwidth, min = 1, max = 100),
      vg_slider(label = "Thresholds", as = thresholds, min = 2, max = 20)
    ),
    vg_mark_heatmap(data_from = "flights", x = ~time, y = ~delay, fill = "density", bandwidth = bandwidth) |>
      vg_mark_contour(
        data_from = "flights", x = ~time, y = ~delay, stroke = "white", stroke_opacity = 0.5,
        bandwidth = bandwidth, thresholds = thresholds
      ) |>
      vg_plot(
        color_scale = "symlog", color_scheme = "ylgnbu",
        x_axis = "top", x_label_anchor = "center", x_zero = TRUE,
        y_axis = "right", y_label_anchor = "center",
        margin_top = 30, margin_left = 5, margin_right = 40, width = 700, height = 500
      )
  )

vg_render(spec)
```

<details>
<summary>Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec</summary>

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/flights-density.html)
exactly, aside from `data.flights.file` (`vg_example_url()` vs. a
relative path) and object key order.
</details>
